name: reliant-forge
description: Guardrails for apps in any agent harness. Deploy with no account: a live URL plus a claim link. The Forge MCP server and a deploy skill: put a Vite, Next.js or Dockerfile app live from Codex, with or without a Reliant account.

interface.shortDescription: Deploy any app with no account: a live URL plus a claim link.
interface.longDescription: Forge is an open-source framework and CLI that puts guardrails on any app and deploys it with no account: `npx -y @reliantlabs/forge@1.10.0 env deploy prod --claimable`. This plugin runs the Forge MCP server and adds a deploy skill. With no Reliant account it puts a Vite or Next.js app, or an app with its own Dockerfile, live and returns a URL plus a claim link that is good for 72 hours. With an account it deploys to the account and checks the release's health.
defaultPrompt: Deploy this app with Reliant Forge and give me the live URL and the claim link.
Why did my last Forge deploy fail, and what do I run next?
